newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harmony acquires remaining Lydex shares.
newsitem.headline: Harmony acquires remaining Lydex shares.

text.p: Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd announced on Wednesday it had acquired the remaining Lydex shares for a cash payment of 10 rand for every Lydenburg Exploration Ltd (Lydex) share held, together with 45 Harmony options for every 100 Lydex shares held.
Lydex will accordingly be delisted from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange with immediate effect.
Harmony last Month announced it had acquired more than 90 percent of Lydex which gave it the majority required to proceed with the compulsory acquisition of Lydex.
Harmony is managed by Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd .
